# Upload test fixtures

nasi.jpg is an unchanged copy of the repository's public/assets/nasi.jpg.
makanlah-preview.mp4 is an unchanged copy of the repository's credited photo-motion sample in public/assets/makanlah-preview.mp4.

These files let the backend's upload and byte-range tests run without the frontend folder. Source attribution is retained in the repository's public/ASSET-CREDITS.md. They are test fixtures, not verified customer posts. The backend Docker image excludes tests/.
